priorFailedAttempts.failure: Linux bind-mount files were owned by the host runner and inaccessible to the named non-root sandbox user.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: The sandbox retains its image-declared non-root user, uses the Worker's private numeric group, and grants materialized paths group-only access; real Golden Stack acceptance passed after the fix.

priorFailedAttempts.stage: isolated Golden Stack cleanup after all required checks passed
priorFailedAttempts.failure: PostgreSQL initdb correctly reset its private data directory to mode 0700, preventing the host runner from deleting the retained workspace.
priorFailedAttempts.disposition: Before container removal, the same non-root sandbox user now restores group rwX only on entries it owns; source files and paths outside that single workspace are excluded.
